Practical info

Getting here, getting around, enjoying it

Getting to Ios

Ios has no airport. You always arrive by sea, and that is where the holiday begins.

  1. By plane

    Fly into Athens, or straight to a nearby island: Santorini, Naxos, Paros, Mykonos or Milos.

  2. By ferry

    From Santorini, Ios is 35 minutes by fast boat. From Piraeus, allow 4 hours by fast boat and 7 to 8 hours by conventional ferry.

  3. The port, then the house

    The boat docks at the port of Ios (Ormos). The house is about 15 minutes on foot or 5 minutes by taxi.

The nearest airports

Shortest crossing times by fast boat. Conventional ferries are slower and cheaper.

Airport Ferry to Ios Connections Website
Santorini (JTR) 35 min from Athinios port All year round jtr-airport.gr
Naxos (JNX) 35 to 45 min All year round greekairports.gr
Paros (PAS) about 1 h All year round ypa.gr
Mykonos (JMK) 1 h 05 min to 1 h 20 min April to October jmk-airport.gr
Milos (MLO) about 2 h 2 to 7 days a week ypa.gr
Athens (ATH) Via Piraeus or Rafina, see below All year round aia.gr

Flights to Naxos, Paros and Milos from Athens: Olympic Air and Sky Express. Flights to Santorini and Mykonos from all over Europe, including with Aegean Airlines.

From Athens

Piraeus port

  • Duration 4 h 10 min by fast boat, 7 to 8 h by conventional ferry
  • Operators SeaJets, Blue Star Ferries
  • Frequency all year round, almost every day
  • From the airport metro line 3 with no change (about 1 h), X96 bus (1 h to 1 h 30 min, day and night) or taxi

Rafina port

  • Duration 3 h 30 min to 4 h 30 min
  • Operators Golden Star Ferries, SeaJets
  • Frequency in season, roughly May to October
  • From the airport the closest port: 20 minutes by taxi, or KTEL bus (about 30 min)

Book your tickets on Ferryhopper or directly with the operators. In July and August, the meltemi wind can delay or cancel sailings, so allow a spare day before your flight home.

Getting around the island

By bus

  • Main route Port, Chora, Mylopotas. In summer, buses run very frequently.
  • Remote beaches Manganari, Agia Theodoti, Psathi: one or two services a day in summer
  • 2026 fares €2.20 to Chora, Mylopotas or Koumbara, €4.50 to Manganari
  • Tickets from the machines at the bus station by the port

KTEL Ios bus timetable

Taxis

  • Taxi 1 +30 697 873 4491
  • Taxi 2 +30 698 568 9849
  • Taxi 3 +30 697 809 6324
  • Taxi 5 +30 697 776 0570
  • Taxi 7 +30 697 703 1708

There are few taxis on the island. In high season, book the day before for your arrival and departure.

Car, scooter, quad

Several rental companies are based at the port. A car is useful for the wild beaches in the south and east. A private parking space awaits you at the house.

On foot

An old cobbled path climbs from the port to Chora: 1.2 km and 20 to 25 minutes uphill. Wear good shoes and avoid the hottest hours.

Cash machines and supermarkets at the port and in Chora. The nearest to the house: the Mini Market on Yalos beach, 5 minutes on foot, and the Aegean Market at the port, open every day from 8 am to 9.30 pm, 10 minutes away.

When to come?

The season runs from May to October. June and September bring warm sea and fewer people. April, May and October are perfect for walking.

Average temperatures on Ios, in degrees Celsius
Jan Feb Mar Apr May Jun Jul Aug Sep Oct Nov Dec
Air, maximum 13°14°16°19° 24°29°30°30°27°23° 19°15°
Air, minimum 9°9°10°12° 16°20°23°23°21°17° 13°10°
Sea 16°15°15°16° 18°22°23°24°24°22° 19°17°

The meltemi, a dry and steady north wind, blows mostly in July and August. It cools the hot days. On very windy days, choose the southern beaches such as Manganari.
